zh: 继续完善提醒与草稿体验，抽屉菜单新增提醒角标，草稿箱图片增加分辨率上限。
导出与本地库同步继续补强，位置信息、备忘录关系元数据和本地关系片段都能更完整保留。
修复桌面多窗口场景下的子窗口同步与数据库写入问题。
en: Continued polishing reminders and drafts with a new drawer badge and image resolution caps inside drafts.
Export and local-library sync flows now preserve location data, memo relation metadata, and local relation fragments more reliably.
Fixed child-window sync and database write issues in desktop multi-window scenarios.

zh: 抽屉菜单新增提醒角标
